description: Golden test to validate pipeline invariance experiment infrastructure
system_prompt: You are a computational biology expert advising on single-cell RNA-seq analysis. Provide specific method recommendations based on the data structure described. Be concise and focus on the most appropriate analytical methods.

trajectory.text: I have single-cell RNA-seq data from mouse embryonic stem cells differentiating into cardiomyocytes over 14 days. I collected cells at days 0, 3, 7, 10, and 14. I need to identify cell populations and understand the structure of my data. What analysis pipeline should I follow?
